title: IBM Landed A $240M AI Deal. Is That Enough?
excerpt: IBM (NYSE:IBM) just signed a $240 million deal with Together AI to build an Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA)-powered AI inference cluster on IBM Cloud, announced August...
content_html:
Maham Fatima

Wed, August 12, 2026 at 1:46 PM CDT 4 min read

IBM (NYSE:IBM) just signed a $240 million deal with Together AI to build an Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA)-powered AI inference cluster on IBM Cloud, announced August 11. Together AI's chief revenue officer Kai Mak says demand is so strong the cluster will sell out two to three months before it even goes live. That kind of confidence from a partner is a good sign for a company whose shares have been under pressure this year. But a single deal, however sizable, still has to answer the bigger question: can IBM turn scattered growth pockets into a real growth story?

Bull Case: A Fresh Bet On AI Demand

The agreement covers an initial cluster built with roughly 2,000 Nvidia Blackwell 300 chips, using the HGX B300 systems and Spectrum-X Ethernet networking, located in the US. Together AI's platform lets businesses run open-source models like DeepSeek, MiniMax and Kimi more cheaply than closed alternatives, and the startup was valued at $8.3 billion in July. Mak told Reuters the company expects full offtake well before the cluster is ready for service, a sign that inference, not just training, is becoming a serious growth lever for IBM Cloud.

That momentum echoes what is already showing up in IBM's numbers. Software revenue rose 5% year-over-year in the most recent quarter, with Red Hat up 11%, the clearest evidence that IBM's shift toward higher-margin, recurring business lines is working. Longer term, CEO Arvind Krishna has said quantum computing could have a "measurable impact" on IBM's top and bottom lines as soon as 2028 or 2029, and he has pointed to the end of the 2030s as when that opportunity could be worth a trillion dollars. Add in a dividend raised for 31 straight years and covered about 2.5 times by expected free cash flow, and the long-term case has more legs than the stock price suggests.

Bear Case: The Growth Problem The Deal Doesn't Solve

None of that changes what happened in the quarter ended June 30, 2026: revenue grew just 1% to $17.2 billion, prompting IBM to cut its full-year guidance from more than 5% growth to a range of 4% to 5%. Consulting revenue was flat, infrastructure fell 7%, and the IBM Z mainframe line dropped 42%, the kind of decline that offsets a lot of AI headlines. Even the software growth investors lean on is decelerating, down from 11% growth in the prior quarter to 5% now. The dividend tells a similar story of caution: April's increase was a single penny per quarter, from $1.68 to $1.69, hardly the raise of a company brimming with confidence. Shares have fallen 33% from their 52-week high of $332.46, a slide that began after preliminary numbers badly missed expectations, and even after recovering some ground, the stock remains down 19% for the year.

2026 年 8 月 12 日星期三下午 1:46 CDT 阅读时间 4 分钟

8 月 11 日宣布，IBM（纽约证券交易所股票代码：IBM）刚刚与 Together AI 签署了一项价值 2.4 亿美元的协议，将在 IBM Cloud 上构建由 Nvidia（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）支持的人工智能推理集群。 Together AI 首席营收官 Kai Mak 表示，需求如此强劲，集群在上线前两到三个月就会售罄。 对于一家今年股价承压的公司来说，来自合作伙伴的这种信心是一个好兆头。 但无论规模有多大，单笔交易仍然需要回答一个更大的问题：IBM 能否将分散的增长空间转变为真正的增长故事？

牛市案例：对人工智能需求的新赌注

该协议涵盖了一个由大约 2,000 个 Nvidia Blackwell 300 芯片构建的初始集群，使用位于美国的 HGX B300 系统和 Spectrum-X 以太网网络。 Together AI 的平台让企业能够比封闭的替代方案更便宜地运行 DeepSeek、MiniMax 和 Kimi 等开源模型，该初创公司 7 月份的估值为 83 亿美元。 Mak 告诉路透社，该公司预计在集群准备好投入服务之前就可以全面承购，这表明推理（而不仅仅是训练）正在成为 IBM Cloud 的重要增长杠杆。

这种势头与 IBM 数据中已经显示的情况相呼应。 最近一个季度软件收入同比增长 5%，其中红帽收入增长 11%，这是 IBM 向利润率更高、经常性业务线转型的最明显证据。 从长远来看，首席执行官 Arvind Krishna 表示，量子计算最早可能在 2028 年或 2029 年对 IBM 的营收和利润产生“可衡量的影响”，他指出到 2030 年代末，这个机会可能价值一万亿美元。 再加上连续 31 年上调的股息以及预期自由现金流的约 2.5 倍，长期前景比股价所暗示的更有支撑力。

看跌案例：交易未能解决的增长问题

这些都没有改变截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的季度发生的情况：收入仅增长 1% 至 172 亿美元，促使 IBM 将全年指导从 5% 以上下调至 4% 至 5%。 咨询收入持平，基础设施下降 7%，IBM Z 大型机系列下降 42%，这种下降抵消了许多人工智能头条新闻的影响。 就连投资者所依赖的软件增长也在放缓，从上一季度的 11% 降至目前的 5%。 股息也讲述了类似的谨慎故事：四月份的股息增长为每季度一美分，从 1.68 美元增至 1.69 美元，这对于一家充满信心的公司来说很难算得上是一次股息增长。 该股已从 52 周高点 332.46 美元下跌 33%，这一下滑是在初步数据严重低于预期后开始的，即使在收复部分失地后，该股今年仍下跌 19%。
